role_boundary.observed: Held-out product measurement or published product-rate estimate. Never an enzyme abundance, kcat, Km, allocation fraction, degradation constant, or calibration input.
role_boundary.physiology_covariates: Biomass, biomass yield, growth, viability and substrate uptake describe the measured culture. Using these at prediction time makes the result physiology-conditioned; they are not enzyme kinetics.
role_boundary.declared_sensor_fit_scope: Parent/user states that the new sensor model imports the reporter ODE and fits sensor_characterisation only, with one plate held out. Existing product-fitted constants and generator physiology-table outcomes do not enter that new fit. This declaration is not a code audit performed by this data-vendoring task.
role_boundary.retrospective_limit: These sources and some outcomes existed in the repository before this benchmark. Product-measurement exclusion from the new fit does not establish a blinded prospective test or remove preexisting GEM priors.
preexisting_priors: The vendored GEM/ecGEM contains biomass composition and storage-carbohydrate fractions and enzyme-capacity assignments. Their use must be disclosed as model priors rather than newly measured product-independent facts.
src/ystwin/fba/stress_pools.py:202-210 already encodes Hakkaart reference trehalose content; it must not be used to pin the target being predicted.
src/ystwin/fba/stress_biomass.py:140-159,208-268 contains other measured glycogen/trehalose composition scenarios.
scripts/calibrate_glycogen.py:46-57 derives synthesis and degradation parameters from glycogen product contents.
src/ystwin/generator/culture.py:193-227,236-269 reads the preexisting van Hoek physiology table; its exclusion from the new sensor fit is the parent/user declaration above.
role_boundary.scope_of_this_export: Source data and metadata only. No predictor, scoring results, allocation parameters, inferred initial dry biomass, inferred initial product pools, or product-derived kinetic inputs are supplied.

coverage.glutathione_gap: No comparable glutathione target was obtained from these three verified primary sources. No placeholder zero, synthetic measurement, or protein quantity is substituted.
coverage.selection: All four Hakkaart Table 1 conditions for both requested storage products; all ten van Hoek Table 1 glycerol rates; both squalene content and titre for every row of Hull Tables 1 and 4, including parental controls and both sequential-production conditions. No condition was selected by prediction error.

csv_schema.missing_semantics: Empty numeric cells are unavailable, not zero. Blank fields can be inapplicable, unreported, or explicitly not determined; study metadata and limitation codes distinguish these. Numeric zero is retained only where reported or in an explicitly documented unit conversion.

case_id.description: Cultivation-condition identifier within a study; repeated across products or metrics from the same condition.

product.description: One of panel_products; measured analyte, not a surrogate enzyme.

observed.description: Published target value. For below_detection_limit rows the printed zero is a censoring code, not an exact measured concentration or rate.

uncertainty.description: Published plus-or-minus magnitude. No uncertainty is inferred or propagated.

uncertainty_kind.description: SD, reported_pm_undefined, or not_reported; definitions below.

units.description: Units of observed, uncertainty and any numerical detection_limit.

detection_limit.description: Numerical analyte detection limit if established. Empty for all present rows; van Hoek does not give a glycerol detection limit.

replicates.description: Reported n for this product measurement, not number of benchmark rows. Biological for Hakkaart; Hull states n=3 without fully resolving pooled-well replication. Empty for van Hoek because no per-row biological n is established.

genotype.description: Verified genotype information only; not a complete genotype where the source does not supply one.

cultivation.description: Culture mode; sequential medium replacement is distinct from an uninterrupted batch.

vessel.description: Reported vessel and working/culture volume in explicitly named units. Gas and agitation details are in study metadata.

ph.description: Cultivation pH setpoint. Hull does not state one. Process-control tolerances are in study metadata, not interpreted as measurement SD.

co2_percent.description: Reported inlet CO2 percentage, not a fraction. Ambient-air percentages are not guessed where unstated.

carbon_source.description: Reported carbon source and medium context.

feed_g_l.description: Meaning depends on feed_basis. Only glucose is included; not total organic carbon. Empty for mixed grass juice rather than treating fructan and other sugars as glucose.

dilution_rate_per_h.description: Published D; actual Hakkaart table values, not all replaced by the nominal 0.025/h.

dilution_rate_uncertainty.description: Published plus-or-minus magnitude; interpretation follows covariate_uncertainty_kind.

growth_rate_per_h.description: Published viable-biomass mu for Hakkaart. For van Hoek, D is used under the paper's explicit mu=D chemostat interpretation, not as an independent growth assay. Empty for Hull.

growth_rate_basis.description: viable_biomass_PI or equal_to_D_as_stated_for_chemostat. These conventions are not interchangeable.

biomass_g_l.description: Reported culture biomass at the target sampling point. Empty for Hakkaart and van Hoek: their Table 1s give biomass yield, not biomass concentration. Never an inferred inoculum.

biomass_basis.description: total_dry_biomass or total_dry_biomass_at_harvest; does not change the separately stated uptake basis.

biomass_yield_g_per_g_glucose.description: Reported biomass yield, not a biomass concentration and not a product yield.

residual_glucose_g_l.description: Measured residual glucose from the same Hakkaart Table 1 condition. Other studies are not filled by cross-sample joins.

viable_fraction.description: Exactly viability_percent/100. For Hakkaart this is the PI membrane-integrity estimate used by the authors to estimate viable biomass, not a separately measured mass fraction or CFU/CFDA viability.

viability_percent.description: Original PI viability percentage from Hakkaart Table 1. Other assays are retained separately in its case metadata.

viability_uncertainty.description: Spread of viability_percent, not of viable_fraction. No SD interpretation is imposed on Hakkaart Table 1.

glucose_uptake.description: Positive means consumption as in both primary tables. Not negated to an FBA exchange sign convention.

oxygen_uptake.description: Positive means consumption. Hakkaart 50% CO2 entries are ND (not determined), left empty; they are not zero oxygen uptake.

uptake_basis.description: viable_dry_biomass_PI for Hakkaart or total_dry_biomass for van Hoek. Empty when no rates are supplied. No basis conversion has been performed.

covariate_uncertainty_kind.description: Meaning of the populated physiological plus-or-minus columns: reported_pm_undefined, SD, or not_reported. Does not assign uncertainty to environmental setpoints.

time_h.description: Actual endpoint time when reported: 48 or 96 for Hull. Empty for unspecified chemostat harvest times.

time_reference.description: Origin/meaning of time_h, or the reason no fixed chemostat time is assigned.

doxycycline_ug_ml.description: Reported final culture dose, not the concentration of replacement medium. Zero denotes the reported no-doxycycline condition.

doxycycline_start_h.description: Dose application time for Hull: 0 for initial supplementation, 48 for sequential supplementation. For a zero dose, 0 identifies the untreated-from-start schedule rather than an administration.

source_location.description: Primary table, row/condition and analyte column. XML row and column numbers are one-based and include header rows and the row-label column.

local_source.description: Existing authoritative local table and one-based line when applicable. Blank means direct primary-source transcription, not a missing citation.

limitations.description: Semicolon-delimited keys into limitation_codes. These do not silently exclude any rows.

metric_definitions.intracellular_content: Product amount associated with harvested cells per gram of total dry biomass. Hakkaart glycogen mass basis has an explicit assay-conversion caveat. This is a stock, not a flux or an enzyme concentration.
metric_definitions.specific_production_rate: Published in-situ glycerol formation rate in the aerobic chemostat, mmol/g total dry yeast biomass/h. Not the paper's offline anaerobic ethanol fermentative-capacity assay.
metric_definitions.culture_titre: Hull's reported cell-associated squalene amount per litre of culture, mg/L; not supernatant concentration, substrate yield, or instantaneous productivity. Content and titre from one case are paired endpoints, not independent experiments.

uncertainty_definitions.SD: The primary table explicitly identifies standard deviation. This is not a confidence interval or standard error.
uncertainty_definitions.reported_pm_undefined: The source prints a plus-or-minus value but the relevant Table 1 footnote does not define it as SD, SEM, mean deviation, or CI. The magnitude is retained without inventing its sampling distribution.
uncertainty_definitions.not_reported: No numerical uncertainty for this table value has been established. Empty uncertainty does not imply zero uncertainty.
uncertainty_definitions.printed_zero_spread: Printed 0 or 0.000 uncertainty is preserved at source precision and is not proof of noiseless measurement.
uncertainty_definitions.replication_dependence: Multiple target rows from a condition share cultures, physiology and assays. Target row counts are not biological replicate counts.

performed_unit_conversions.not_inferred: No conversion between viable and total dry-biomass uptake rates is performed.

performed_unit_conversions.kind: exact conversion of reported 2% w/v glucose
performed_unit_conversions.not_inferred: Does not account for carbon in 2% peptone and 1% yeast extract.

not_performed: No OD or cell-count to dry-mass conversion.
No biomass concentration reconstructed from feed and biomass yield.
No initial product pool set to zero.
No product content converted to a synthetic kinetic input or to an additional supposedly independent rate target.
No glycogen hydrolysis correction, molecular-weight conversion, or uncertainty propagation.
No batch rate estimated from endpoint titre divided by time.
No figure digitisation or interpolation of missing source conditions.

hakkaart2020.title: Physiological responses of Saccharomyces cerevisiae to industrially relevant conditions: Slow growth, low pH, and high CO2 levels
verified_material: Full-text Table 1, id bit27210-tbl-0001, including footnote and superscripts
BIT-117-721-s001.docx, Appendix 1.1 and Appendix 1.7, parsed from Word text elements

culture.medium: Chemically defined; vitamin solution 2-fold and trace-element solution 1.5-fold relative to the cited medium; Appendix 1.1 reports additional iron and biotin adjustments.
culture.ph_control: pH 5.0 or 3.0, maintained by addition of 12.5% NH4OH solution; continuous medium for pH 3 adjusted with sulfuric acid.
culture.gas_at_50_percent_co2: 1:1 flow mixture of compressed air and pure CO2. The oxygen fraction changes with this treatment; no numerical O2 percentage or kLa is inferred.

hakkaart2020.biomass_gap: Table 1 supplies biomass yield (gx/gs), not biomass g/L. Therefore all biomass_g_l cells remain empty. The approximately 2.5 g/L in assay Methods is a laboratory dilution for weighing, not the undiluted culture biomass.
hakkaart2020.basis: Table 1 q values use viable dry biomass xv estimated by PI staining. Storage contents and biomass yield use total biomass x. Published viable mu is retained rather than replaced by D. The PI estimate is not substituted with CFDA or CFU-FACS values.
hakkaart2020.uncertainty: Table 1 defines biological replicate counts and analyte-specific superscripts, but not the meaning of its plus-or-minus values. Table 2 explicitly says SD for a different experiment; that definition is not silently transferred to Table 1.
hakkaart2020.other_viability_source: Same Table 1, XML rows 7-8; plus-or-minus meanings remain undefined. CFDA and CFU-FACS estimates do not have the same operational definition as PI membrane integrity.

product_assays.glycogen: Glucose released after overnight alpha-amyloglucosidase treatment, measured enzymatically. Appendix 1.7 does not explicitly state whether an anhydroglucose mass correction was applied; original mg/g values are preserved.

hakkaart2020.missing_oxygen: Both 50% CO2 qO2 cells are ND, explicitly not determined; not nondetect and not zero.
hakkaart2020.low_ph_qualifier: Table 1 footnote reports oscillations in dissolved oxygen and exhaust CO2/O2 at pH 3 at either CO2 level.
hakkaart2020.transcriptome_role: Not imported into these files and not an absolute protein-abundance or kinetic measurement.

vanhoek1998.title: Effect of specific growth rate on fermentative capacity of baker's yeast
vanhoek1998.verified_material: Live PMC HTML Table 1, footnotes a-c, and Methods. Parsed actual HTML table cells; all ten glycerol/glucose/O2/biomass-yield rows agree numerically with the existing TSV.
vanhoek1998.retrieval_caveat: A Python urllib request returned a page without article tables and was not counted as verification. A subsequent curl response contained the full article and its table; the hash refers to that verified HTML response.

culture.strain: DS28911, prototrophic commercial baker's yeast; not CEN.PK113-7D or CBS8066
culture.vessel: Applikon laboratory fermentor; total vessel capacity not stated in the verified Methods
culture.ph_tolerance_kind: Reported process-control plus-or-minus, not an analytical SD
culture.gas: Air; CO2 percentage not numerically specified
culture.medium: Defined mineral medium; the Methods separately describes 2% glucose precultures, which are not the chemostat feed.
culture.steady_state: No detectable oscillations; at least five volume changes after a condition change and less than 2% variation over two volume exchanges. Typically six to eight exchanges were needed. No row-specific harvest time in hours is inferred.
culture.growth_rate_convention: Paper explicitly identifies chemostat specific growth rate with D; no independent growth measurement or viable-biomass correction supplied.

vanhoek1998.product_assay: In-situ culture glycerol by HPLC (Aminex HPX-87H at 60 C, 5 mM sulfuric acid, 0.6 mL/min), refractive-index detection.
vanhoek1998.units_and_censoring: Footnote a: fluxes are mmol per gram dry yeast biomass per hour. Footnote c: 0 means below detection limit. Eight glycerol zeros remain marked below_detection_limit. No numerical glycerol detection limit is given; the glucose assay's approximately 5 micromolar limit is not a glycerol limit.
vanhoek1998.uncertainty_and_replication: Table 1 prints single rounded numbers, no numerical spread. Figure legends describe duplicate assays at different time points within the same steady-state cultures; this is not evidence for two independent biological cultures per table row. No uncertainty or biological n is invented.
vanhoek1998.biomass_gap: Biomass yield is present; biomass concentration and residual glucose are not numerically tabulated per row. They remain empty rather than reconstructed.
vanhoek1998.not_the_target: The offline anaerobic ethanol fermentative-capacity assay and its rates are different measurements and are not imported as glycerol targets.

hull2014.title: Co-production of ethanol and squalene using a Saccharomyces cerevisiae ERG1 (squalene epoxidase) mutant and agro-industrial feedstock
verified_material: Table 1 (Tab1) XML rows 3-14, both squalene columns and matched biomass
Table 4 (Tab4) XML rows 3-10, both squalene columns and matched biomass
Methods: Sterol analysis of strains; Simultaneous co-production; Sequential production
hull2014.selection: All twelve Table 1 strain-dose cases and all eight Table 4 cases, including both asterisked sequential cases. Each supplies one content and one titre row: forty target rows, twenty cases.

genotypes.YUG37: Parental strain; full genotype not supplied in this article.
genotypes.YUG37-ERG1: YUG37-derived strain with ERG1 expression under a doxycycline-repressible tetO7-CYC1 promoter system (source typography tet0_7-CYC1). No numerical Erg1 protein abundance or dose-response is supplied.

culture_volume.scope: Explicitly reported for simultaneous cultures only

table4_grass_juice.sequential_event: Initially without doxycycline. At 48 h remove 100 uL supernatant and replace with 100 uL fresh grass juice containing doxycycline to reach final culture concentrations 5 or 50 microgram/mL. Resume with a medium shaking regime until the 96 h harvest; no numeric rpm stated.

feedstock_composition.source: Table 3, GJ t0 column; separately measured feedstock, not case-specific uptake data
feedstock_composition.qualification: Total_as_reported is not added to the components and is not forced to equal the sum of rounded means. Fructan is not assumed fully accessible to yeast. No glucose-equivalent feed or matching substrate-consumption rate is inferred.

hull2014.assay: Cell-associated squalene and sterols by GC-MS; dry biomass measured gravimetrically. Values transcribed from tables, not recomputed as mean content times mean biomass.
hull2014.uncertainty_and_replication: Tables 1 and 4 explicitly report mean values, n=3, plus-or-minus SD. Bioscreen Methods describes three wells per treatment and pooled-well biomass/sterol analyses. The number of independent biological pooled samples underlying each SD is not resolved here.
hull2014.paired_endpoints: Squalene content, titre and biomass from one case are related measurements. Covariance is unavailable. They must not be treated as independent validation cultures or used to infer a kinetic parameter.
hull2014.source_unit_conflict: For sequential cases the Results text labels 12.0 and 12.7 as g squalene/L, but Table 4 explicitly labels the titre column mg/L. This export follows Table 4 and flags the conflict rather than multiplying by 1000.
unavailable_inputs: Numerical ERG1 protein response to doxycycline
Specific glucose and O2 uptake on these target cultures
A growth rate valid over the entire batch
hull2014.excluded_derived_inputs: Table 2 minimum doubling times on grass juice are not converted into constant full-batch growth rates. No endpoint titre/time is relabelled a measured production rate.

limitation_codes.hakkaart_context_gaps: No Table 1 biomass concentration, initial dry biomass, initial product, fixed harvest time, or matched absolute enzyme capacity. Reported OD660 inoculum range is not converted to dry mass.
limitation_codes.viable_vs_total_biomass: Hakkaart q and viable mu refer to PI-estimated viable biomass, while storage content and biomass yield refer to total dry biomass. The conventions cannot be mixed without an explicit additional model.
limitation_codes.uncertainty_pm_undefined: The Hakkaart Table 1 plus-or-minus statistic is not explicitly identified. Do not silently treat it as SD, SEM or a CI.
limitation_codes.gas_composition_covaries: The 50% CO2 treatment replaces half the air stream with CO2 and changes oxygen fraction at the same time.
limitation_codes.oxygen_uptake_not_determined: Primary Table 1 reports ND for qO2 under 50% CO2. Missing is not zero consumption or anaerobiosis.
limitation_codes.oscillatory_culture: Hakkaart reports dissolved/exhaust-gas oscillations at pH 3. These data do not establish a perfectly stationary intracellular state.
limitation_codes.glycogen_hydrolysis_mass_basis_ambiguous: Glycogen is measured via glucose released by hydrolysis; the source does not explicitly establish an anhydroglucose correction. Keep the reported mass basis or retain a declared interpretation uncertainty.
limitation_codes.vanhoek_context_gaps: No per-row biomass concentration, residual glucose, viability, fixed harvest time, or initial dry biomass. Source is chemostat physiology, not a batch trajectory.
limitation_codes.uncertainty_not_tabulated: No numerical uncertainty for the van Hoek Table 1 value; duplicate-assay figure error bars are not digitised or substituted.
limitation_codes.industrial_strain_transfer: DS28911 is an industrial baker's yeast, not the generic model strain or CEN.PK. Strain transfer is an unresolved source of error.
limitation_codes.prior_repository_use: This table previously informed repository physiology/generator work. The new sensor-fit exclusion is declared, but the evaluation remains retrospective with possible preexisting model priors.
limitation_codes.nondetect_unknown_limit: Published zero means below detection limit; the glycerol limit is not supplied. No epsilon, exact zero truth, or numerical censoring threshold is manufactured.
limitation_codes.hull_context_gaps: No initial dry biomass, initial product, pH, uptake rates, oxygen-transfer parameters or full genotype; only harvest biomass is reported. Reported initial cell counts are not dry mass.
limitation_codes.content_titre_paired: Content and titre share one culture condition and related biomass data. They are not two independent biological experiments and are not alternative kinetic inputs.
limitation_codes.doxycycline_response_unmeasured: Genetic ERG1 repression is described, but quantitative doxycycline-to-Erg1 abundance or activity is unavailable. Do not infer it from squalene targets.
limitation_codes.complex_grass_juice: Feedstock contains multiple measured sugars including fructan and unspecified complex nutrients. Total sugar cannot be assumed to be glucose or fully assimilable carbon.
limitation_codes.pooled_wells: Bioscreen biomass and sterol measurements use pooled wells; tables state n=3 but independent biological replication is not fully resolved by the Methods.
limitation_codes.cross_environment_confounding: YPD versus grass-juice comparison changes medium, temperature, vessel, aeration/shaking and duration together; not an isolated one-variable effect.
limitation_codes.medium_replacement_at_48h: Sequential Hull conditions include removal and replacement of supernatant plus a shaking-regime change at 48 h, not an uninterrupted batch.
limitation_codes.initial_density_not_explicit_for_sequent: The sequential Methods does not restate initial cell density; no initial dry mass or inherited cell-count value is filled for that protocol.
limitation_codes.sequential_text_titre_unit_conflict: Table 4 mg/L is used for the two sequential titres despite the Results prose incorrectly printing g/L for the same numeric values.
